title: Hammerly
body:
![Hammerly Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db6ac2646d4cd1da798a82f3a77b92e38b6a9408.png)
The **Hammerly mod** introduces a set of new **combat hammers** in Minecraft, ranging from **wooden** to **netherite** tier. These hammers are simple but potent, offering a powerful alternative to traditional weapons. 

## Features:
- **Unique Combat**: Hammers deal more damage than swords but have a slower attack speed, perfect for players who want powerful, heavy strikes.
- **Easy Progression**: The crafting recipes are simple, and the hammers are effective throughout the game.

Ideal for those who enjoy a straightforward, impactful combat experience, the **Hammerly mod** brings a fresh way to engage with mobs and other players!

![Hammer Weaponry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7fa1f183347c3053e89078ccb7c0826d0dc01a3.png)
